titleEn: Send an approved template (outside the 24h window)

ar: العميل كلمني من يومين وعايز ابعتله
مش قادر اكتب للعميل، بيقولي الـ window اتقفل
en: The 24h window closed, how do I message the customer?
How do I send a template?

steps: Pick an APPROVED template and fill the variables
edgeCases: Only APPROVED templates are listed (empty list = none created yet: no templates screen)
Custom template names show as raw snake_case (display-name map is hard-coded)
On the shared platform number: marketing templates are refused, templates come from the platform catalogue, wallet pays Meta
Number quality drops to YELLOW/RED or WhatsApp restricts the account: campaigns auto-pause, no new templates until recovered; campaigns never restart by themselves
Meta may reclassify a utility template as marketing (cost + consent change)
No active package: sends, agent and number connect answer 403 plan_required (no free plan, WA-NOFREE-1); a past_due package keeps replies/confirmations up to 7 days
gaps: Merchant cannot create templates in UI (see templates.create-submit)
